messages.subject: Urgent — shock from rented generator
messages.body:
Calling about this too but putting it in writing so there's a record. One of our guys got an electric shock from the generator we're renting. Touched the metal casing and got a clear jolt through his arm. He seems alright but we've pulled the machine out of use.

This needs to be dealt with today.

Oulujoen Betonityö Oy

messages.subject: Re: Urgent — shock from rented generator
messages.body:
Got your message and the call. We're treating this as priority — I've flagged the unit and the service team will be in contact today about inspecting or collecting it.

Please keep it disconnected and out of use until then.

Petri Isokangas
Senior Coordinator

messages.subject: Re: Urgent — shock from rented generator
messages.body:
While we're at it — we got a 220 EUR damage charge on the plate compactor from booking RB-20265862. We don't agree with that, the wear was from normal use. Can you waive the charge?

Oulujoen Betonityö Oy

messages.subject: Re: Urgent — shock from rented generator
messages.body:
One more thing. We need to book some site fencing, about 50 metres. What are the delivery options to our site?

Oulujoen Betonityö Oy
